defects.claim: A throwing requestRedraw on first retain leaves the readers count incremented with no release, stranding a phantom reader.
defects.scenario: The supplied requestRedraw throws during the first retain; readers stays at 1 with no release; frames keep being copied; the next real first reader skips the redraw.
defects.cause: count incremented before a call that can throw

defects.claim: A zero-area source box falls back to scale 1 and still returns sampled color, so it can hide a visible layer below.
defects.scenario: A source box of zero width or height whose backing canvas is populated, stacked above a visible layer; sampling near its origin returns its pixel instead of the lower layer's.
defects.cause: zero extent falls back to scale 1 instead of being treated as empty
